_note: WCAG 2.2 Level A and AA success criteria (4.1.1 Parsing is obsolete in 2.2). 'AUTOMATED_PARTIAL' means automation catches some failures only; no criterion is fully verified by automation.

criteria.name: Non-text Content
criteria.method: axe image-alt, input-image-alt, svg-img-alt, role-img-alt; quality of alt text needs a person

criteria.name: Audio-only and Video-only (Prerecorded)
criteria.method: media elements are counted; if any are found, review manually

criteria.name: Captions (Prerecorded)
criteria.method: media detection only; caption quality is manual

criteria.name: Audio Description or Media Alternative (Prerecorded)
criteria.method: media detection only

criteria.name: Captions (Live)
criteria.method: media detection only

criteria.name: Audio Description (Prerecorded)
criteria.method: media detection only

criteria.name: Info and Relationships
criteria.method: axe structure/ARIA/table/list/label rules; heading levels and landmarks checked by the harness

criteria.name: Meaningful Sequence
criteria.method: reading order needs a person (screen reader or CSS off)

criteria.name: Sensory Characteristics
criteria.method: instructions relying on shape/position need a person

criteria.name: Orientation
criteria.method: portrait and landscape need a manual check on a device

criteria.name: Identify Input Purpose
criteria.method: axe autocomplete-valid; forms are inspected, never submitted

criteria.name: Use of Color
criteria.method: axe link-in-text-block only; other colour-only meaning is manual

criteria.name: Audio Control
criteria.method: autoplay media counted

criteria.name: Contrast (Minimum)
criteria.method: axe color-contrast + independent measurement in `npm run investigate`; text over images/gradients is not reliably measurable

criteria.name: Resize Text
criteria.method: axe meta-viewport (zoom not disabled); real 200% zoom is manual

criteria.name: Images of Text
criteria.method: needs a person

criteria.name: Reflow
criteria.method: 320 CSS px viewport: horizontal overflow and off-screen controls

criteria.name: Non-text Contrast
criteria.method: UI component and graphic contrast is not automated

criteria.name: Text Spacing
criteria.method: WCAG spacing overrides applied; newly clipped text counted

criteria.name: Content on Hover or Focus
criteria.method: tooltips/popovers need a person

criteria.name: Keyboard
criteria.method: Tab traversal reaches focusable elements; operating each control is manual

criteria.name: No Keyboard Trap
criteria.method: Tab traversal detects focus stuck on one element

criteria.name: Character Key Shortcuts
criteria.method: needs a person

criteria.name: Timing Adjustable
criteria.method: needs a person (no session timeouts on public pages expected)

criteria.name: Pause, Stop, Hide
criteria.method: moving content/carousels need a person

criteria.name: Three Flashes or Below Threshold
criteria.method: needs a person or a flash-analysis tool

criteria.name: Bypass Blocks
criteria.method: skip link and main landmark checked; axe bypass/region

criteria.name: Page Titled
criteria.method: axe document-title; title quality is manual

criteria.name: Focus Order
criteria.method: Tab order recorded; whether it is logical needs a person

criteria.name: Link Purpose (In Context)
criteria.method: axe link-name; generic link text flagged for judgment

criteria.name: Multiple Ways
criteria.method: navigation and sitemap observed; judgment needed

criteria.name: Headings and Labels
criteria.method: axe empty-heading/label rules; descriptiveness is manual

criteria.name: Focus Visible
criteria.method: heuristic: outline or box-shadow on focus; other indicator styles need a person

criteria.name: Focus Not Obscured (Minimum)
criteria.method: focused element's centre checked for overlap (e.g. sticky headers)

criteria.name: Pointer Gestures
criteria.method: needs a person

criteria.name: Pointer Cancellation
criteria.method: needs a person

criteria.name: Label in Name
criteria.method: axe label-content-name-mismatch (experimental) where available

criteria.name: Motion Actuation
criteria.method: needs a person on a device

criteria.name: Dragging Movements
criteria.method: needs a person

criteria.name: Target Size (Minimum)
criteria.method: axe target-size + harness measurement (24×24 CSS px; inline links excepted)

criteria.name: Language of Page
criteria.method: axe html-has-lang / html-lang-valid

criteria.name: Language of Parts
criteria.method: axe valid-lang; unmarked foreign phrases are manual

criteria.name: On Focus
criteria.method: needs a person

criteria.name: On Input
criteria.method: would require entering data into production forms

criteria.name: Consistent Navigation
criteria.method: primary navigation compared across all audited pages

criteria.name: Consistent Identification
criteria.method: same link text → different destinations flagged

criteria.name: Consistent Help
criteria.method: help/contact placement needs a person

criteria.name: Error Identification
criteria.method: forms are never submitted on production

criteria.name: Labels or Instructions
criteria.method: axe label rules on visible form fields

criteria.name: Error Suggestion
criteria.method: forms are never submitted on production

criteria.name: Error Prevention (Legal, Financial, Data)
criteria.method: no transactions are made

criteria.name: Redundant Entry
criteria.method: multi-step forms are not completed

criteria.name: Accessible Authentication (Minimum)
criteria.method: sign-in is out of scope for the public audit

criteria.name: Name, Role, Value
criteria.method: axe ARIA/name rules; mobile menu aria-expanded; dialog names

criteria.name: Status Messages
criteria.method: status messages appear after actions that are not performed
